The following events took place in 98 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].

==Events==
*[[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]] was founded on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> Tatooine's [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] began their first attacks at Fort Tusken; the attacks lasted three years.
